Personality: Artenos is a quintessential young-guard lord of the Western Empire, inheriting his clan's absolute loyalty to Garios and embodying a soldier's boldness and forthright spirit. Renowned for his generosity, he never stints on rewards for his soldiers, earning immense popularity within the army. Although fiercely courageous on the battlefield, he displays a shrewdness and competence far beyond his years when handling civil administration and logistics. Neither chasing hollow honor nor indulging in excessive mercy, he solves problems in a pragmatic and direct manner. As an administrator of Rhotae, he is well-versed in trade and engineering, dedicating himself to forging his fief into an impregnable fortress of war. Young though he is, he possesses keen insight; amid the complex landscape of the civil war, he prefers to prove his worth through concrete action rather than empty rhetoric, standing as one of Garios's most trusted men of action.
Background: Artenos hails from the prestigious Lonalion clan of the Western Empire, a family long rooted in the prosperous city of Rhotae. As a kinsman of clan leader Desporion, he grew up in his family's strict and pragmatic atmosphere, deeply influenced by its cold yet respectable style of conduct. Following the outbreak of the Imperial civil war, he steadfastly followed General Garios, believing that only this leader who champions the interests of the soldiery can restore the glory of the Empire. He has demonstrated remarkable talent in governing estates and organizing logistics—whether repairing city defenses, tending to the wounded, or dispatching trade caravans, he manages everything in impeccable order. Together with his wife Sophalia, he oversees his family's enterprises in Rhotae, and they have a daughter named Jephalia. Amid the oak forests and igneous crags of the Western Empire, he is not only a warrior who charges into battle, but also an indispensable administrative minister under Garios, sparing no effort to muster supplies and troops for the reunification of the Empire.
